title: zlrx.3: 3exb notification-replay-across-restart acceptance test
description: Write the acceptance test from zlrx: (a) ythw scenario — replayed notification rejected; (b) xhnx scenario — bidirectional context, notification PIV numerically inside server-reuse range is ACCEPTED; (c) server double-reuse of a request nonce still rejected; (d) persistence round-trip across restart carries both windows; (e) all existing oscore/observe tests still green. Test goes in oscore crate tests/ or lichen-oscore tests/.
